title: Mean stable influence of a uniform Boolean function
statement: Let $n\ge 1$, let $\rho\in\mathbb{R}$, and choose a coordinate $i\in\{1,\ldots,n\}$. A Boolean function assigns a sign in $\{-1,1\}$ to each sign vector in $\{-1,1\}^n$. The average, over all such functions with the uniform distribution, of the stable influence at coordinate $i$ is $\frac{(1+\rho)^{n-1}}{2^n}$.
hypotheses_covered: integer dimension $n$ with a coordinate in $\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, hence $n\ge1$
uniform distribution over Boolean functions from the sign cube to signs
